channel.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who?
channel.desc: Scooby and Shaggy meet up with their biker buddy, Axl Rose, on a tour of famous roadside diners along iconic Route 66. The diner they're heading for is famous for its varieties of delicious pies. But soon, they all find themselves embroiled in a crazy mystery involving spooky mudmen, the lost ruins of an ancient civilization and a treasure of Spanish gold.
